# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 text correctness** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the engine to m153 and improves GPU text and failure handling. Linux font fallback can choose a different face. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pin fonts when Linux fallback must be deterministic** — Fontconfig fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters. This is a behavior change, not a managed API or native ABI change. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia m153** — Advances the bundled renderer to milestone m153. The HarfBuzzSharp .300 package revision distinguishes this Skia milestone and does not upgrade native HarfBuzz. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU atlas and failure correctness** — Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking, propagates native Ganesh task/flush/submission failures, and rejects draws after failed buffer uploads under memory pressure. Existing managed flush calls remain void. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Cached-data lifetime** — Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed storage. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))
- **Windows HarfBuzz passes BA2007** — Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 advanced the release process without adding consumer-facing changes to Preview 1.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6...v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, the Linux font-fallback selection change, and a cached-data lifetime fix. HarfBuzzSharp moved to the .300 package revision without a native engine upgrade.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.3...v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)
